duplicate_cohort_R00573_R00714.resolution: SAME STUDY / SAME COHORT - resolved by reading both abstracts: identical pre-registered design, identical recruitment window (Jun 2020-Mar 2021), identical N=10,953 and identical COVID+/COVID- subgroup counts (3,356 / 602). R00714 is the medRxiv preprint (10.1101/2023.01.16.23284630); R00573 is the published journal version (Chemical Senses, 10.1093/chemse/bjad020). Neither was retrieved at full text in this phase, so neither is in the included set and there is no double-count. If retrieved later: count ONCE, journal version primary, preprint as companion report.

full_text_retrieval.routes: Europe PMC fullTextXML (PMCID) first; ClinicalTrials.gov full record for registry records; Unpaywall best OA location (PDF/HTML) as second route; every not-retrieved record had at least two routes attempted - see fulltext/retrieval_log.csv per record

full_text_screening.kappa_note: Low kappa despite 86.8% agreement is the prevalence paradox: with 87% of retrieved texts includable, chance-expected agreement is high; disagreement concentrated in taste-separability and design-type borderlines, all resolved by adjudicators reading the full texts (fulltext/adjudication/ft_decisions_1.csv, ft_decisions_2.csv).

included_by_question_provisional.note: Multi-membership counts (one study may map to several questions); operational definitions in scripts/merge_ft.py; to be verified field-by-field at extraction. Adjudicated records carry the adjudicator's Q mapping.
